build_attention_backend: build a SparseVideoGen2AttentionBackend that wires the sparse video generation attention into the sglang attention framework
build_attention_metadata: build a SparseVideoGen2AttentionMetadata containing kmeans centroids, frame dimensions, and cache state for sparse video attention
build_attention_metadata_builder: build a SparseVideoGen2AttentionMetadataBuilder that prepares metadata from raw latent shapes, patch sizes, and kmeans parameters
run_sparse_attention_forward: run the SparseVideoGen2AttentionImpl forward pass that applies kmeans clustering and sparse attention or full attention based on layer and timestep thresholds
test_kmeans_clustering: test the kmeans_clustering method that initializes or refines query and key centroids using batch kmeans with Euclidean distance
